nodes.label: setAutoBusOffRecovery(true)
nodes.rationale: Default false. Motor EMI spikes can push CAN into Bus Off and it stays dead until chip reset; true lets STM32 auto-rejoin when noise clears.

nodes.label: setIRQPriority(5, 0) CAN interrupt
nodes.rationale: STM32 priority 0 highest, 15 lowest (default 15). CAN IRQ should outrank slow UI/timers but sit below a critical emergency-stop pin interrupt; 5 is a safe automotive choice.

nodes.label: Telemetry frequency guidance (ACMA, p36)
nodes.rationale: ACMA primary concern is interference to licensed users; low-power desert devices unlikely a problem, but out-of-band equipment risks being swamped by licensed remote installations, so choose an interference-free frequency.
